zoe: Quick plan: rolling change window 04:00 UTC - coordinated push for api v3.5, runtime v1.12, router v2.6.1. Need owners for immediate rollback.
ash: I'll pin router v2.6.1 and keep v2.6.0 hot. Canary steps: 5% -> 25% -> 75%. Auto-fallback router -> v2.6.0 on error spike.
mike: API gates: p95 < 700ms, 5xx < 0.3% over 5m. Manual rollback for API, service lead calls `deploybot`.
tara: Runtime has new batching heuristics. Toggle RUNTIME_BATCH=false to disable. Rollback if kvcache_eviction > 10% or any OOM. I'll be oncall.
ops-bot: auto-fallback rules loaded: router error delta > 0.35% over 180s triggers auto-switch. API/runtime manual-only.
deploy-bot: deploybot: scheduled canary 04:05 UTC -> wave-6112 canary (5%). Use `deploybot promote --wave wave-6112 --step canary`.
zoe: runbook: canary 5% -> check +10m -> 25% -> check +15m -> 75% -> finalize. If any gate fails, stop and escalate to #oncall.
ash: will wait 90s after fallback before draining to preserve connections.
mike: add client-compat smoke at 25% (1000 requests). If structured-output diff >8% hold.
tara: preflight smoke passed; mem delta +1.5%.
zoe: post-deploy: update release-notes and tag docs. If rollback: `deploybot rollback --wave wave-6112 --service <svc>` and post brief reason here.
deploy-bot: deploybot: canary advanced to 25% at 6112233460.
ops-bot: no auto-fallback triggered. Monitoring live.
zoe: +10m check shows api p95 390ms, 5xx 0.05%, router err 0.02%, kvcache evict 1.4% 1 proceeding to 75%.
ash: promoting to 75% now.
zoe: thanks all. Keeping thread as canonical runbook and rollback record.
